crossRefs.note: For as the body is one, and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is…
So then you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens with the saints and of the household of…
They shall leave none of it until the morning, nor break a bone of it. According to all the statute of the Passover…
but when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was already dead, they didn’t break his legs.
For these things happened that the Scripture might be fulfilled, “A bone of him will not be broken.”

translations.web: It must be eaten in one house. You shall not carry any of the meat outside of the house. Do not break any of its bones.
translations.bsb: It must be eaten inside one house. You are not to take any of the meat outside the house, and you may not break any of the bones.
translations.kjv: In one house shall it be eaten; thou shalt not carry forth ought of the flesh abroad out of the house; neither shall ye break a bone
translations.asv: In one house shall it be eaten; thou shalt not carry forth aught of the flesh abroad out of the house; neither shall ye break a bone thereof.
